dbt-prod-guard.description: Blocks a dbt command on a production target (prod, production, prd or AI_KIT_PROD_TARGETS) unless AI_KIT_ALLOW_PROD=1.

git-guard.description: Blocks the git commands that discard work for good (reset --hard, clean -f, checkout or restore of the whole tree, branch -D) and a forced push to a main branch (main, master or AI_KIT_PROTECTED_BRANCHES).

bq-cost-guard.description: Blocks bq query without --dry_run and without --maximum_bytes_billed.

infra-prod-guard.description: Blocks terraform apply or destroy and the kubectl commands that change a cluster, when the workspace, folder, variable file, context or namespace names production (prod, production, prd or AI_KIT_PROD_TARGETS), unless AI_KIT_ALLOW_PROD=1.

protected-paths.description: Always blocks agent writes to the configuration of the kit and of the CLIs (also through simple shell commands); also blocks writes under the patterns listed in <repo>/.ai-kit/protected-paths. On by default.

whats-new.description: At session start (startup, resume), tells the agent once what is new: the installed version's CHANGELOG section and the NEWS.md entries aimed at the active Team, read from the copies in ~/.ai-kit/news (no network). It also runs the local friction upkeep. On by default.
